Screens/AboutUs.title: About
Screens/AboutUs.description: SIA Architect and Interior Designer on various project scales for individuals, entrepreneurs and municipalities. Background and references.
Screens/AboutUs.introduction:
Claire Duchamp works on various project scales for individuals, entrepreneurs and municipalities.
Originally from the Lyon region, she grew up in an agricultural and industrial area. Large natural spaces mark his aesthetic and his taste for contemplation and freedom.
She did the first part of her studies in Lyon, then a second in Paris where she graduated from the Paris Malaquais school as an architect.
She then worked in renovation in Paris, then in the development of new constructions in architectural offices in Valais and Vaud.
Today based in Vevey, in the center of the Vaud Riviera, she enjoys developing projects in a territory for which she feels desire and wonder.

Screens/Services.explanation:
The agency works on various project scales for individuals, entrepreneurs and municipalities.
It relies on the architect-client dynamic as a design process.
We are concerned with an aesthetic highlighting the singularities of the site, the program and the client.
Screens/Services.introduction: Convinced that architecture has its source in specificities, Claire Duchamp defends projects designed in relation to the singularities of contexts and project owners.
Screens/Services.listening-text: Listening and the architect-client dynamic are at the heart of the development process of our projects, in order to achieve a tailor-made and unique result.
Screens/Services.reactivity-text: We strive to demonstrate flexibility and open-mindedness to adapt as quickly as possible to challenges, unforeseen events and changes during the process.
Screens/Services.singularity-text:
From detail to the whole, our transversal vision of the project allows us to think from the gesture to the typology through the atmospheres.
This process highlights your singularity.
